rust_summary: submitting bounded depth-tested world primitives and full-screen tint or vignette for a client frame.
doc_summary: `draw_world_line(start, end, color, width)`, `draw_world_quad(corners, color)`, `draw_world_textured_quad(corners, uv, color, texture)` and `draw_world_billboard(center, size, uv, color, texture)` submit world-space primitives during a client world frame hook. Color is ARGB; line width is 0.5 to 4 pixels, billboard dimensions are positive and at most 256 blocks, and UV rectangles are normalized. Each frame accepts at most 256 primitives, depth-tested with no depth writes and consumed once; primitives beyond 256 camera blocks are discarded. Textures must be current same-renderer GUI handles. For late submission opt into RenderNeeds::pre_post and use WorldPrePost.draws directly with fragment @API:world_pre_post@. Empty queues add no passes or GPU allocations. `draw_post_tint(color)` and `draw_post_vignette(color)` submit at most 16 full-screen effects per frame, after the world and before the HUD. Vignette alpha controls its darkening strength. Bundles need fragment @API:world_lines@.
